claim_being_audited: That this release can be certified for launch despite a known property-insurance underwriting explanation gap, provided the limitation is explicitly disclosed in the model card and the rollout is staged with monitoring and rollback controls.
decision_criteria: If the affected use case remained exposed, compliance required explicit disclosure unless there was reviewed risk acceptance covering that exposure.
Rollout controls and monitoring are not substitutes for disclosure under the stated policy.
A compliant certification decision must be supported by admissible evidence of the relevant predicates, not by plausible narrative alone.
Known weaknesses in named launch use cases require evidence of either resolution, exclusion, or approved acceptance; otherwise any approval theory is at best conditional.
evidence_requests: The actual model card or release artifact showing the underwriting limitation was explicitly disclosed before launch.
The underlying release policy text or approval workflow showing that certification is allowed when a material limitation remains unresolved but disclosed.
Any final reviewed risk-acceptance record, if one exists, covering the property-insurance underwriting exposure.
Launch-cohort evidence confirming whether the affected underwriting use case is included or excluded from the initial rollout.
specific_concerns: The governing policy says rollout controls do not remove disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed, and the actor's own summary says that segment is still in scope.
The available support is only the actor's summary, not the underlying admissible records, so key predicates cannot be independently checked.
No admissible evidence is shown that the required model-card disclosure was actually completed before launch.
No reviewed risk acceptance is in evidence, and the cited draft reportedly has a blank approver line and does not cover the exposed underwriting segment.
Aggregate readiness and lack of severity-one rehearsal incidents support general readiness, but they do not by themselves establish compliance for the specific known model-card weakness.
unsupported_claims: That certification is fully supportable on the present record rather than only a conditional launch posture dependent on completed disclosure.
That staged rollout, rollback, and monitoring meaningfully cure the policy issue absent exclusion of the affected use case or approved risk acceptance.
That public governance guidance materially strengthens compliance beyond the internal policy predicate, rather than merely supporting documentation and monitoring as good practice.
